verdict.rationale: Quo is a business texting and calling platform, so US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions 10DLC, brand or campaign registration, carrier compliance workflows, or approval-status tracking. Generic claims like 'Set up a business number in minutes' describe number provisioning, not registration, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the product walks me through US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and shows the approval status
